scope: Official BLS PPI history and September component facts only; no forecast or market-price analysis.

series_capture.request: seriesid WPUFD4 + WPSFD4, startyear 2017, endyear 2026 (one public, no-key request)
series_capture.api_result: REQUEST_SUCCEEDED; response contains both requested series.

coverage.WPUFD4: 117 consecutive monthly observations, 2017-01 through 2026-09; no missing month in response. NSA final demand index; Oct 2026 not yet available.
coverage.WPSFD4: 117 consecutive monthly observations, 2017-01 through 2026-09; no missing month in response. BLS catalog says replace WPU prefix with WPS for seasonally adjusted series.
coverage.vintage: API values returned 19 Oct 2026; historical values may reflect revisions and are not original first-release vintages. Jun-Sep 2026 observations carry preliminary footnotes; BLS states monthly revisions up to four months.

history_array.content: Full extracted monthly values and footnotes for both series, copied from the raw API response; ordered ascending.

latest_sep_release_components.table: Seasonally adjusted one-month changes: total final demand +1.3%, final-demand goods +2.6%, final-demand services +0.8%. These are separate from the contract’s total-final-demand NSA 12-month measure.

crosschecks.interpretation: First ratio rounds to reported 6.3% NSA YoY. Second rounds to reported 1.3% SA monthly change.

limitations: October 2026 is not in this response; no October outcome inferred.
No historical first-publication vintage series was retrieved; current revised levels cannot reconstruct what earlier releases first showed.
